name: Padjelantaleden Etapp 2: BLT Gisuris/Kisurisstugan - BLT Låddejåhkå/Låddejåkkåstugan
description: BLT Gisuris/Kisurisstugan to BLT Låddejåhkå/Låddejåkkåstugan. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Låddejåhkå drinking water: Mapped drinking-water point at or near the Låddejåhkå cabin camp. Treat as mountain water with normal treatment/risk caveats.
notes: Route geometry uses researched OSM relation 19111627 because the official Naturkartan linework is split across BD58 and BD57 with Kutjaure/Nordkalottleden access context.
STF uses Kisurisstugan and Låddejåkkastugan/Låddejåhkåstugan variants; BLT/Padjelanta commonly use Gisuris and Låddejåhkå; Padjelanta.se uses Låddejåkkå.
Official stage distance is 23 km; OSM computes 22.053 km and cropped Naturkartan about 22.154 km.
OSM relation 19111627 is per-stage and clean, while Naturkartan requires crops from BD58 and BD57.
Some field reports describe no difficult crossings, while 2024 and Utsidan reports flag Vierttjajågåsj as potentially difficult after rain/high water.
BLT hut pages mention cash-only kiosk payment, while newer price/opening pages may mention card payment. Some pages retain 2025 labels while Padjelanta.se has April 2026 update notes.
